ideas.pitch: An interactive logical reasoning and aptitude assessment platform tailored specifically for college coding rounds.
ideas.title: CodeSprint Logic Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the event's focus on logical reasoning, aptitude, and programming basics seen in Round 1 MCQs.

ideas.pitch: A real-time collaborative code-debugging and problem-solving simulator for college students to sharpen their competitive programming skills.
ideas.title: PeerCode Debug Arena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the competitive coding objective of Navachar organized by E-Cell MIT Meerut.

ideas.pitch: A leaderboard and performance analytics dashboard for tracking college-wide student progress in coding competitions.
ideas.title: SkillMatrix College Ranker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides immediate utility for organizers and participants to track year-based round performances on Unstop.

ideas.pitch: An educational web tool that visually breaks down fundamental programming basics and sorting algorithms for beginner coders.
ideas.title: AlgoVisualizer Interactive
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aids beginners and advanced programmers alike, matching the inclusive eligibility criteria of the fest.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered MCQ generator that creates customized programming and aptitude tests based on syllabus topics.
ideas.title: CodeFest Quiz Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the MCQ Challenge format of Round 1 with automated question generation.
